title: Vista Phase 4 checks
intro: Five batches of changes, none of which Core tests can reach — they are all ImGui, input, or the game camera.
Answers save in this browser as you go. Hit Download results at the end and send me the file.

steps.text: In game: `/xlplugins` -> Dev Tools -> Vista -> reload icon.
Type `/vista`, set the mode dropdown to Edit.

sections.title: Batch 1 - the scene survives a zone change
sections.blurb: The teleport no longer clears anything. The camera should still come back on its own.

groups.title: Teleport with work in progress
groups.need: The zone handler is gone. The camera is released by a separate path, the BetweenAreas flags, which this confirms still fires.

steps.text: Build a scene worth losing: two tracks, three points each, one added to the playlist. Rename a track.

steps.action: Teleport to another zone
steps.expect: Camera returns to the character during the loading screen.

steps.action: Open `/vista` after landing
steps.expect: Both tracks, their points and their names are still there.

steps.action: Look at the Playlist panel
steps.expect: The entry is still there.

steps.action: Mode -> Edit, then Ctrl + Z
steps.expect: An edit from before the teleport undoes. The history survived.

steps.action: Look at the world
steps.expect: The tracks draw at their old coordinates, wherever that lands. Underground or in the sky is expected, not a fault.

steps.action: Drag the scene anchor
steps.expect: The whole scene moves to you, as it always did.

steps.action: Start a Live shot, then teleport mid-playback
steps.expect: Playback stops, camera returns, scene survives.

groups.title: Name plate and greyed tracks
groups.need: The name lost its colour tint and gained a dark plate at 1.5x. Non-edited tracks went darker and more opaque, which trades bright-zone washout for possible dark-interior competition.

steps.action: Look at a track name
steps.expect: White text on a dark rounded plate, noticeably larger than before.

steps.action: Stand somewhere bright and open
steps.expect: The name reads clearly.

steps.action: Go somewhere dark indoors
steps.expect: The name still reads clearly.

steps.action: Add a second track, edit the first
steps.expect: The non-edited track is a dark line, clearly visible in bright daylight.

steps.action: Compare the two tracks
steps.expect: Edited (near-white) and non-edited (dark) are still easy to tell apart.

steps.action: Look at the non-edited track indoors
steps.expect: Still visible. If it now disappears into a dark background, say so — that is the trade-off and the fix is an outline.

steps.action: Check a point marker's number on a non-edited track
steps.expect: Readable.

steps.action: Look at the scrub row at the bottom of the Vista window
steps.expect: It sits centred between the separator above and the window's bottom edge.

sections.title: Batch 3 - input remap
sections.blurb: Q/E fly, Ctrl+Q/E roll, Space drives the transport, C does nothing.

groups.title: The new scheme
groups.need: One rotation: roll vacated Q/E, up/down moved onto them, which freed Space.

steps.action: Hold E, then Q
steps.expect: Camera flies up, then down. No roll.

steps.action: Hold Ctrl + E, then Ctrl + Q
steps.expect: Camera rolls right, then left. No vertical movement.

steps.action: Hold C
steps.expect: Nothing happens.

steps.action: Press Space in Edit with points on the track
steps.expect: The preview plays, as the Play button does. Press again to pause.

steps.action: Press Space while the character is in shot
steps.expect: The character does not jump.

steps.action: Press Ctrl + Space in Edit
steps.expect: The preview restarts from the beginning.

steps.action: Mode -> Live, press Space
steps.expect: Playback starts and pauses, same as the Play button.

steps.action: Press Ctrl + Space in Live
steps.expect: Playback restarts from the beginning.

steps.action: Click into a Vista text field and type a space
steps.expect: A space is typed. The transport does not fire.

steps.action: Open game chat and type a space
steps.expect: A space is typed. The transport does not fire.

steps.action: Mode -> Off, press Space
steps.expect: The character jumps. Vista is not claiming it when released.

groups.title: Gizmo space
groups.need: The text label and two radios became three icon buttons. Rotate is local-only and has no space of its own, which the wider gap is meant to say.

steps.text: Select a point so the Point window opens.

steps.action: Look at the Point window's top row
steps.expect: Three icon buttons: globe, cube, then a gap, then rotate. No "Gizmo" text. The position, rotation and FoV icons run down a column on the left, under the globe.

steps.action: Hover each
steps.expect: Move (world), Move (local), Rotate.

steps.action: Click the globe and drag the gizmo
steps.expect: The point moves along world axes, as it always did.

steps.action: Turn the point's yaw, then click the cube and drag
steps.expect: The arrows now follow the point's own facing, not the world's.

steps.action: Click rotate and drag a ring
steps.expect: Rotation works as before.

steps.action: From Move (local), press R twice
steps.expect: R goes to Rotate, then back to Move (local) — not Move (world).

steps.action: Select a track anchor
steps.expect: Rotate is greyed out and a Move button is lit.

steps.action: Start a drag, then click another gizmo button mid-drag
steps.expect: The mode does not change until you let go. Nothing errors.

groups.title: Camera window and resets
groups.need: Two new buttons left of the fly-speed feather. The Camera window writes to the free camera directly, so it is not an undo step.

steps.action: Look at the top row, left of the feather
steps.expect: Two new icons: a ruler and a camera.

steps.action: Check the row still fits
steps.expect: Nothing overlaps or is pushed off; the fly-speed slider still ends under the track row's trash icon.

steps.action: Roll the camera with Ctrl + E, then click the ruler
steps.expect: Roll snaps back to level.

steps.action: Click the camera icon
steps.expect: A Camera window opens in the Point window's layout: the gizmo and copy/paste/delete row greyed out, then X/Y/Z, Pitch/Yaw/Roll and FoV with their icons on the left.

steps.action: Drag X, then Y, then Z
steps.expect: The camera moves along each axis as you drag.

steps.action: Drag Yaw, then Pitch
steps.expect: The camera turns. Pitch stops at its limit rather than flipping.

steps.action: Roll the camera with Ctrl + E, then drag Yaw
steps.expect: Yaw changes only. It does not bleed into pitch — this is the case most likely to be wrong.

steps.action: Drag Roll
steps.expect: The horizon tilts.

steps.action: Drag FoV
steps.expect: The view widens and narrows, and stops at the limits.

steps.action: Mode -> Off or View
steps.expect: The Camera window hides by itself.

steps.action: Back in Edit, fly around with the Camera window open
steps.expect: The numbers track the camera live.

steps.action: Select a point, click the history icon left of FoV
steps.expect: The point's FoV becomes the one you are looking through.

steps.action: Press Ctrl + Z
steps.expect: That reset undoes in one step.

steps.action: Roll the camera, then click the Camera window's rotation icon
steps.expect: Roll levels. On the Point window the same icon is only a label.

steps.action: Drag the camera's FoV, then click the history icon left of it
steps.expect: FoV returns to what the game had before you entered Edit.

steps.action: Select the scene anchor
steps.expect: Copy, paste and delete end exactly at the right edge of the Z field. No extra width.

steps.action: Select a point, then the scene anchor, then a point again
steps.expect: The window keeps the same width throughout; it never stays wide.

steps.action: Select a Look At point
steps.expect: The FoV reset icon is greyed out, as are the fields it lacks.

groups.title: Ctrl during a key drag
groups.need: Without Ctrl the drag trims: the next key stays put and the track keeps its length. With Ctrl it ripples: later keys travel and the track changes length.

steps.text: Three points on the track. Open the Timing window with the chart icon.

steps.action: Drag the middle key right, no modifier
steps.expect: The last key stays where it is. Total duration unchanged.

steps.action: Undo, then Ctrl + drag the middle key right
steps.expect: The last key moves right with it. Total duration grows.

steps.action: Look at the points table during that drag
steps.expect: The first leg's duration changes; the second leg's does not.

steps.action: Release and press Ctrl + Z
steps.expect: The whole ripple undoes in one step.

steps.action: Start a Ctrl + drag, let go of Ctrl mid-drag, keep dragging
steps.expect: It stays a ripple. The edit does not change kind halfway.

steps.action: Start a plain drag, press Ctrl mid-drag
steps.expect: It stays a trim.

steps.action: Ctrl + drag the last key
steps.expect: Only the track's length changes.

steps.action: Ctrl + drag a key hard left, past zero
steps.expect: It stops at the leg's shortest duration rather than inverting.

steps.action: Add a hold to a point, then Ctrl + drag its key
steps.expect: The hold travels with the key and keeps its own duration.

groups.title: Free notes
groups.need: Not reachable from the UI: that six UI files now share one refusal logger (behaviour identical, only visible if a refusal stops being logged), and that the Director is now driven through Reverse and Ping-pong by tests rather than only by hand.

steps.label: Anything no row asked about
steps.placeholder: crashes, log spam, something that felt off
